ctx.x: Yeah. I tell you another fellow was going good then when Dave had his band, a fellow by the name of Frank Davis. He was a drummer, marvelous drummer. And well Frank was getting a lot of work too and we were young and new in the business and Frank would get so much work he couldn't do it, he would throw it our way. That helped us to keep getting a lot of work too. And I remember making a picture, I never get to see that picture. They showed it there at the Queen Theater there in Houston. And we went out to this…
Oh yeah. Well when I left there I left there with Ida Cox.

Incidentally I see where she gotta write up where she stuff Yeah, she cut out and cut some records again. I'd like to hear that. I played for her. And that little boy out of Houston, I don't know if you remember him, dog, my name was Skinny, he couldn't read but he could play the best piano player ever in my life. He was really terrific.
